name: Hermes Agent
author: NousResearch
description: Nous Research's self-improving agent: sessions, skills, memories and scheduled jobs, with a web dashboard on :9119 and a key-gated OpenAI-compatible API on loopback :8642. Official image, single container. Its data dir is ~/services/hermes-agent/data — deliberately NOT ~/.hermes, which belongs to the separate native hermes-gateway install this box already runs; the two coexist and teardown only ever touches the Docker one. Dashboard basic-auth credentials are generated into .env; the tailnet is still the real boundary.

control._comment: Dashboard and API are s6-supervised inside the one container, so a single part covers both. The tile's health probe is the API /health endpoint because the dashboard itself sits behind basic auth.
